children: Earnings season reaches peak intensity this week as 142 companies report quarterly results, anchored by major releases across mega-cap technology, pharmaceuticals, energy, aerospace, and consumer goods.
Out of the 142 companies reporting, 122 exceeded EPS expectations, while 13 fell short and 6 matched estimates. Notably, 111 firms posted year-over-year earnings growth.
Out of the 142 companies reporting, 112 exceeded revenue expectations, while 28 fell below analyst estimates and 1 matched estimates. Notably, 112 firms posted year-over-year revenue growth.
Let’s take a look at some of the companies that reported earnings this week:

fell 5.70% despite delivering massive Q1 FY2027 beats, with revenue up 299.0% Y/Y to $19.95B (vs. $16.26B estimate) and non-GAAP EPS hitting $1.81 (vs. $1.23 estimate), driven by accelerating demand for its Total AI and IT Datacenter Solutions. Full-year FY2027 revenue is now expected between $72.0B and $82.0B.
